defectRegressionTests.note: All 11/11 defect regression tests (FRONTEND-001..FRONTEND-011) PASS; 54/54 total tests pass in --profile=report with 0 DB orphans.

findings.title: Concurrent 401 responses trigger un-mutexed parallel POST /api/v1/auth/refresh calls colliding with single-use refresh rotation
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: added module-scoped single-flight refreshInFlightPromise mutex in apps/web/lib/api.ts coalescing concurrent 401s behind one POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, updating setSocketToken, and retrying with skipAuthRefresh: true. [FRONTEND-001] PASS and api/01 PASS.

findings.title: POST /api/v1/auth/login 401 invalid credentials triggers unintended silent /auth/refresh and retry
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: excluded /auth/login and /auth/logout alongside /auth/refresh and /auth/device in shouldAttemptSilentRefresh() inside apps/web/lib/api.ts so failed logins throw ApiError(401) immediately. [FRONTEND-002] PASS and api/01 PASS.

findings.title: loginAdminWithPassword leaves non-admin HttpOnly cookies active after rejecting non-ADMIN role
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: loginAdminWithPassword revokes issued cookies via POST /auth/logout (skipAuthRefresh: true), clears setSocketToken(null), and resets store state before throwing the admin privilege error. [FRONTEND-003] PASS and api/02 PASS.

findings.title: initAuth unconditionally calls POST /auth/device without checking /users/me, overwriting Admin/Responder sessions on reload and minting DB rows on logout
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: initAuth() checks GET /users/me first to preserve active ADMIN/VERIFIED_RESPONDER/USER sessions and only bootstraps /auth/device on 401; logout() clears session cleanly without minting an anonymous DB row; added resetAnonymousIdentity() for /profile reset. [FRONTEND-004] PASS and workflows/01 PASS.

findings.title: alerts/page.tsx opens Socket.IO synchronously before awaited initAuth() resolves, breaking private user:<id> GEOFENCE_ALERT room attachment
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: alerts/page.tsx now attaches GEOFENCE_ALERT via getSocket() inside awaited bootstrap() after initAuth() resolves (with React cleanup cancellation), lib/socket.ts handles authenticated token upgrades/logout disconnects cleanly, [FRONTEND-005] PASS, live 3/3 PASS, and Chromium E2E connects /alerts cleanly as an authenticated socket user.

findings.title: alerts/page.tsx fabricates synthetic https://push.safetymap.bd endpoint & dummy keys when PushManager subscription fails/is absent
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: removed synthetic https://push.safetymap.bd fallback and dummy keys; wired PushManager.subscribe with NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY and honest error reporting when unavailable/denied; added push and notificationclick listeners to public/sw.js. [FRONTEND-006] PASS and forms/01 5/5 PASS.

findings.title: ReportIncidentModal submits malformed ': ' on whitespace input and lacks <=1000-character composed description guard
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: ReportIncidentModal now rejects !title.trim() || !description.trim() before setting submitting state and enforces fullDescription.length <= 1000 matching backend Zod limits. [FRONTEND-007] PASS and forms/01 PASS.

findings.title: safe-zones/page.tsx triggers redundant 3x GET /safe-zones loops via selectedZone dependency and submits NaN/null coordinates without pre-flight validation
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: removed selectedZone from fetchSafeZones useCallback deps using functional updater setSelectedZone((prev) => prev ?? data[0]), eliminating the 3x GET /safe-zones mount loop in E2E; added name.trim().length < 2, Number.isFinite(lat/lng), and Bangladesh bounds validation before POST. [FRONTEND-008] PASS and e2e/01 PASS.

findings.title: admin/page.tsx silently swallows dashboard fetch failures (console.warn only) and submits unvalidated <3-char reasons / non-UUID user IDs
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: fetchAdminData now surfaces API failures via showToast(..., 'error') and visible error banner with Retry; purge/reject/ban/unban handlers enforce reason.trim().length >= 3 and UUID_PATTERN validation prior to calling /admin endpoints. [FRONTEND-009] PASS.

findings.title: apiFetch lacks a default AbortController timeout guard and /report page snaps blank manual coordinates to Banani while quick prompts exceed maxLength=500
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: apiFetch now enforces a default 25,000ms AbortController timeout linked with external AbortSignal and cleans up timers/listeners in finally; /report caps quick prompts at 500 chars via .slice(0, 500) and manages manual coordinate drafts cleanly without snapping empty inputs to Dhaka Banani. [FRONTEND-010] PASS, api/01 PASS, e2e/01 PASS.

findings.title: Concurrent useAuthStore.initAuth() mounts duplicate POST /auth/device requests (201 + 400 StrictMode race and double auth on every page load)
findings.observedEvidence: Fixed & verified: added module-scoped single-flight initAuthPromise deduplicating StrictMode/concurrent initAuth() calls cleanly. [FRONTEND-011] PASS and Chromium E2E logs show single GET /users/me per route transition without duplicate /auth/device writes.
